description: Calculate the d-band center of the Ag(111) surface from projected density of states.
user_prompt: Calculate the d-band center of the Ag(111) surface (FCC, Fm-3m). Extract the d-band center (in eV relative to the Fermi level) from the surface Ag atoms' d-orbital projected DOS and report the final value.

references: Ruban, Hammer, Stoltze, Skriver, and Norskov, J. Mol. Catal. A: Chem. 115, 421-429 (1997).
Takigawa, Shimizu, Tsuda, and Takakusagi, RSC Adv. 6, 52587-52595 (2016).
method.modeling: Use a clean close-packed Ag(111) slab and project the DOS on top-layer Ag atoms only.
method.rationale: The -4.30 eV target is the clean Ag close-packed-surface diagonal d-band center from the Ruban/Hammer/Norskov tables, reproduced explicitly in the Takigawa compilation. Ruban defines the quantity as the centroid of the d-type DOS on a surface atom, matching the benchmark full_d_band_centers_rel_fermi_eV convention. Ag has a filled 4d shell well below E_F, so the main failure mode is truncating the DOS energy window; the 0.4 eV absolute tolerance covers projection and integration-window differences between LMTO-ASA/LDA literature values and VASP/PBE/PAW runs.
